method: Consolidation of ten frozen local receipts and current engine definition. No new vendor policy refresh, download, third-party execution or capture.

proposedScope.operation: Personal English passive-construction review, manual revision and recheck, for explicitly described editions; not full Grammarly replacement.
proposedScope.technicalUsability: CLI/library setup must be prominent; not presented as a plug-in replacement for nontechnical users.
proposedScope.qualification: Use dated scoped evidence on six axes. Material unresolved selected-operation text paths block positive classification. Do not require eternal zero packets, universal no telemetry or secure memory erasure as invented mandatory rules.

rows.edition: 6.6 direct CLI, pinned JRE/distribution, explicit passive rules and PICKY mode
rows.evidence: Observed passive/manual-active controls; selected source/default config review; bounded Java and owner OS controls; complete distribution snapshot checked.
rows.materialLimit: No end-to-end binary/source equivalence or all-runtime/deletion proof. Those are limits, not automatic universal requirements. Publication wording must describe selected operation, explicit output/diagnostic limits and technical setup.
rows.decision: Prioritize scoped draft dossier using existing evidence; no more CLI capture expansion by default.

rows.edition: npm1.0.8 direct Node function with locked dependency set, stock checks, passive-only output profile
rows.evidence: Full function workflow and14 loaded source files; manual active revision; selected source has no direct I/O; text-bearing results explicit.
rows.materialLimit: Caller output/memory handling is part of profile. CLI/editor/cloud integrations excluded. No full grammar replacement, secure deletion or host-wide no-network promise.
rows.decision: Prioritize scoped draft dossier; state caller-memory and limited linguistic coverage, no more detector hardening by default.

rows.edition: 3.24.0 CLI, fixed single Microsoft.Passive rule, plain stdin/JSON, explicit ini/no-global, child VALE_* removal
rows.evidence: Eight controls plus threshold control; controlled passive/revision; empty effective endpoint; selected source paths and optional NLP/profiling identified.
rows.materialLimit: Selected startup/config/data path review is partial; configuration package composition and dependencies not completely traced. Does not inherit write-good privacy evidence even when heuristics are similar.
rows.decision: Resolve one bounded configuration/rule-load path question before deciding whether a third scoped dossier is supportable; no new owner capture.

rows.edition: 12 installed English Correction with documented global rewrite/sync controls
rows.evidence: Vendor control documentation; exact global/per-document semantics separated.
rows.materialLimit: Owner no/uncertain entitlement, no observed installed profile.
rows.decision: Defer runtime work without purchase. Access gap is not a privacy defect.

rows.materialLimit: Applicable edition notice and installed rights/workflow unresolved.
rows.decision: Defer, no purchase; do not use web policy as installed evidence.

rows.evidence: Manual passive workflow and bounded browser/network/choice records exist.
rows.materialLimit: Some selected text/storage/control paths remain unresolved; separate browser profiles cannot be merged.
rows.decision: Hold. Existing writing-function acceptance is not privacy acceptance.

rows.evidence: Dated policy and feature statements in earlier receipts.
rows.materialLimit: Feature-specific text retention/logging/control mapping not completed.
rows.decision: Hold separately from local CLI; no inherited local privacy attribute.

rows.edition: Local HTTP server plus selected client
rows.materialLimit: Client not selected, server not run, fallback/logging paths unknown.
rows.decision: Defer as separate operating mode, not another product to reach minimum3.

distinctions.graphQualifiedZero: No new scoped graph claims applied; not equivalent to eight negative privacy verdicts.
distinctions.researchReady: Prioritized dossier means enough evidence to draft narrow claims and list residual limits, not already qualified.
distinctions.threeFamilies: LanguageTool/write-good/Vale are three product families, but Vale remains pending and common heuristics do not prove independent accuracy. Modes and dependency ports cannot inflate counts.
distinctions.historical: PR5.82 priorities are historical, not an instruction to redo already completed CLI research. All old receipts remain unchanged.

nextSteps.action: Prepare concrete local-only draft scope/claim wording for LanguageTool CLI and write-good library, with evidence-backed limits and setup tradeoffs. Keep graph/publication unchanged until candidate claim review.
Finish bounded Vale config-to-rule-load mapping to determine selected executable rule set and external configuration hooks; then make a clear support/hold decision.

If three distinct scoped candidates can be supported, prepare a selective draft graph/engine scope proposal with pricing, tradeoffs, dated sources and validation. Otherwise retain route hold with specific remaining blocker; do not force completion.

decision: Shift from repeated probes to explicit draft decisions and one bounded Vale gate.21/9/1, zero applied privacy qualifications unchanged. No production SQL/import/publication.
